vignette: A toddler is brought in after a fall onto the mouth. The upper lip is swollen and a piece of a primary incisor crown cannot be found.
stem: Which approach to the soft-tissue examination is most appropriate?

options.text: Examine the lips, mucosa, gingivae and frenula for lacerations and hematomas, and examine the lips for embedded tooth fragments
Limit the examination to the teeth, because soft-tissue assessment applies only to the permanent dentition
Inspect only the lips and omit the mucosa, gingivae and frenula
Omit the search of the lips for the missing fragment, assuming it was swallowed
